title: Make the three repeats real: ComfyUI served identical cached images
goal: Repeats of a case differ in seed or bypass the ComfyUI cache, so generator variance is measured
acceptance: A committed failing test first (fake ComfyUI): iterations 2 and 3 of a case do not submit the same seed and workflow as iteration 1 (the seed is derived from the task seed and the iteration, recorded per result), or the submission defeats the cache; today `generate.mjs` repeats are cache hits (ComfyUI "Prompt executed in 0.00 seconds", 0.5 s wall, identical image SHA-256 for all 18 images of the 2026-11-27 night, 6 distinct)

The docs say which seeds the iterations use (done: decision page, "Repeat seeds"); the re-run of the six cases x 3 is picked up by the 2026-11-28/29 night via docs/NIGHTS.md once merged: it measures real variance (judge verdict agreement across seeds) and is recorded, with no real model run in this change
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
